title: ForceBody: Force-Paired Parametric Body Motion with Torque Uncertainty
abstract: arXiv:2611.22769v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Forces and torques drive human motion, central to biomechanics, robotics, and physics-aware animation, yet they are often absent from learning-based motion pipelines for body reconstruction and generation. Some motion datasets provide force annotations, but the paired motion sequences are incompatible with the parametric body models used in modern learning pipelines. In addition, existing datasets typically obtain joint torques through inverse dynamics, which is inherently sensitive to the quality of the input kinematics; however, they do not quantify the reliability of these torque estimates. We close this gap with ForceBody, the first dataset to bring ground truth force supervision into a parametric body representation, shipped with per-sample torque uncertainty. ForceBody pairs the SKEL body model with ground reaction forces and inverse-dynamics joint torques across 10,386 motion trials (9.7M frames, 26.9 hours) from 140 subjects. E

translated_title: ForceBody：带力矩不确定性的力配对参数化人体运动
translated_abstract: 力和力矩驱动人体运动，是生物力学、机器人学和物理感知动画的核心，但它们在用于人体重建与生成的基于学习的运动流水线中常常缺失。一些运动数据集提供了力的标注，但其配对的运动序列与现代学习流水线中使用的参数化人体模型不兼容。此外，现有数据集通常通过逆动力学获得关节力矩，而逆动力学本质上对输入运动学数据的质量非常敏感；然而，这些数据集并未量化其力矩估计的可靠性。我们通过 ForceBody 弥补了这一空白，这是首个将真值力监督引入参数化人体表示的数据集，并为每个样本附带力矩不确定性。ForceBody 将 SKEL 人体模型与地面反作用力和逆动力学关节力矩配对，涵盖来自 140 名受试者的 10,386 次运动试验（970 万帧，26.9 小时）。
tldr: ForceBody 是首个将真值力与力矩监督引入参数化人体模型（SKEL）的大规模运动数据集，涵盖 140 名受试者的 10,386 次运动试验，并首次为每个样本提供力矩不确定性的量化。
en_tdlr: ForceBody is the first dataset to bring ground-truth force supervision into a parametric body representation (SKEL), pairing forces and joint torques across 10,386 motion trials from 140 subjects, and uniquely providing per-sample torque uncertainty quantification.
